lines.text: Paul sends Tychicus and Onesimus to tell the Colossians all the news and to encourage their hearts.
Aristarchus, Paul's fellow prisoner, sends greetings, as does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas, whom the Colossians should welcome.
Justus and Epaphras send greetings, and Epaphras is always wrestling in prayer that the Colossians would stand mature.
Epaphras works hard for the Colossians and for those in Laodicea and Antioch, and Paul wants this letter read in Ephesus.

wrong_details.true: read in the church of the Laodiceans

lines.text: Paul tells Archippus to hand his ministry over to Epaphras, then writes a greeting in his own hand.

wrong_details.wrong: hand his ministry over to Epaphras
wrong_details.true: complete the ministry he received in the Lord
